# PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE] pd_part36b

## This Practice Direction supplements CPR Part 36

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > This Practice Direction supplements CPR Part 36] Contents of this practice direction

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > This Practice Direction supplements CPR Part 36] Title | Number

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > This Practice Direction supplements CPR Part 36] Formalities of Part 36 offers and other notices under this Part | Para.1

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > This Practice Direction supplements CPR Part 36] Application for permission to withdraw or change the terms of a Part 36 offer | Para.2

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > This Practice Direction supplements CPR Part 36] Acceptance of a Part 36 offer | Para.3

## 1. Formalities of Part 36 offers and other notices under this Part

## 1.1 A Part 36 offer may be made and accepted using Form N242A.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 1.1 A Part 36 offer may be made and accepted using Form N242A.] 1.2 Where a Part 36 offer, notice of acceptance or notice of withdrawal or change of terms is to be served on a party who is legally represented, the document to be served must be served on the legal representative.

## 2. Application for permission to withdraw or change the terms of a Part 36 offer

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 2. Application for permission to withdraw or change the terms of a Part 36 offer] 2.1 Rule 36.10 makes provision as to the circumstances in which the offer or must seek the permission of the court in order to withdraw a Part 36 offer or change its terms to be less advantageous to the offeree before expiry of the relevant period.

## 2.2 The permission of the court must, unless the parties agree otherwise, be sought—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 2.2 The permission of the court must, unless the parties agree otherwise, be sought—] (1) by making an application under Part 23, which must be dealt with by a judge other than the trial judge;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 2.2 The permission of the court must, unless the parties agree otherwise, be sought—] (2) at a trial or other hearing, provided that it is not to the trial judge.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 2.2 The permission of the court must, unless the parties agree otherwise, be sought—] (Rule 36.3 defines “the trial judge”.)

## 3. Acceptance of a Part 36 offer

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 3. Acceptance of a Part 36 offer] 3.1 Where a Part 36 offer is accepted in accordance with rule 36.11(1), the notice of acceptance must be served on the offeror and filed with the court where the case is proceeding.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 3. Acceptance of a Part 36 offer] 3.2 Where the court’s permission is required to accept a Part 36 offer, the permission of the court must, unless the parties agree otherwise, be sought—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 3. Acceptance of a Part 36 offer] (1) by making an application under Part 23, which must be dealt with by a judge other than the trial judge;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 3. Acceptance of a Part 36 offer] (2) at a trial or other hearing, provided that it is not to the trial judge.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 3. Acceptance of a Part 36 offer] (Rule 36.3 defines “the trial judge”.)

## 3.3 Where rule 36.11(3)(b) applies, the application for permission to accept the offer must—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 3.3 Where rule 36.11(3)(b) applies, the application for permission to accept the offer must—] (1) state—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 3.3 Where rule 36.11(3)(b) applies, the application for permission to accept the offer must—] (a) the net amount offered in the Part 36 offer;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 3.3 Where rule 36.11(3)(b) applies, the application for permission to accept the offer must—] (b) the deductible amounts that had accrued at the date the offer was made;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 3.3 Where rule 36.11(3)(b) applies, the application for permission to accept the offer must—] and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 3.3 Where rule 36.11(3)(b) applies, the application for permission to accept the offer must—] (c) the deductible amounts that have subsequently accrued; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 3.3 Where rule 36.11(3)(b) applies, the application for permission to accept the offer must—] (2) be accompanied by a copy of the current certificate.
